name: pfSense
author: Atrium
description: Gateway status, interfaces and firewall rule count through the community REST API.

baseUrl.title: pfSense URL
baseUrl.description: The web address of your firewall, for example https://10.0.0.1.

verifyTls.title: Verify TLS
verifyTls.description: pfSense ships a self-signed certificate. Turn this off to accept it on purpose.

secrets.label: REST API key
secrets.hint: Install the pfSense REST API package (pfrest), then create a key under System, REST API, Keys for a user with read-only privileges.

endpoints.label: Gateway status
endpoints.description: Each gateway, online or down, with delay and loss.

endpoints.label: Interfaces
endpoints.description: Every interface with its status and address.

endpoints.label: Firewall rule count
endpoints.description: How many firewall rules are configured.
